name: Mechanics of Materials (Strength of Materials)
summary: Stress, strain and deformation in loaded members under axial load, torsion, bending, shear and combined loads, plus column buckling.

topics.name: Stress and strain; normal and shear stress
Hooke's law, Poisson's ratio and properties from the stress-strain curve
Axially loaded members: deformation, statically indeterminate bars, thermal stress
Torsion of circular shafts: shear stress, angle of twist, power transmission
Flexural (bending) stress in beams; composite beams
Transverse shear stress and shear flow
Stress transformation, principal stresses and Mohr's circle
Beam deflection: integration, superposition and moment-area methods
Column buckling: Euler load, end conditions, secant and Johnson formulas
Strain energy and introduction to energy methods
Stress concentrations and introduction to failure theories
